meta.description: View, query, and interpret VCF/BCF variant files with bcftools and cyvcf2.
meta.audit_type: final-pass correction and self-audit at the exact source commit
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md
meta.execution_note: Exact commit 7c665843f733a0833f21fe95a7c7199376159059. Archived synthetic inputs 1--5 were rerun from the prior canonical audit, plus two fresh cases. Environment: bcftools 1.24 and cyvcf2 0.34.0 in WSL science. The archived conversion/index write was executed in a temporary Linux directory to avoid Windows mount latency.

scientific_integrity.detail: The PL/GL transform, conditional GQ definition, header recommendations, and BCF requirements were checked against the current hts-specs VCF specification; no patient inference is made.

practice_boundaries.detail: All inputs are synthetic and operations are local read, query, convert, or filtered-write examples.

methodological_ground.detail: Archived checks cover site/genotype levels, missingness, gVCF blocks, indexing, and filtered writing; fresh checks cover QUAL=0 and caller-emitted PL/GQ fields.

code_usability.detail: The shipped viewer ran from the exact commit and was compiled with py_compile.

functional_suitability.note: View, query, field interpretation, gVCF triage, conversion, and Python access are covered.

reliability.note: Corrected QUAL=0 display, caller-dependent GQ wording, VCF/BCF header requirements, and current plain-gzip diagnostic.

performance_context.note: The 350-plus-line core guide is thorough but exceeds the 300-line target and remains dense.

agent_usability.note: The level-and-Number principle and explicit traps prevent common silent interpretation errors.

human_usability.note: Usage prompts and focused command examples are clear.

security.note: No secrets, network calls, destructive source operations, or patient-specific guidance.

maintainability.note: The small executable example is useful, but synthetic regression cases are audit artifacts rather than shipped tests.

agent_specific.note: Routes to normalization and joint calling are strong; broad compatibility claims are now qualified.

inputs.note: Header/sample/table query, SNP=8, indel=3, total=11, query -H header behavior, and exact shipped viewer execution passed.
AD-derived heterozygote allele balance, QUAL-vs-GQ distinction, low-GQ S7 carriers, and missing exclusion passed.
SYN_S6 missingness 76/361, missing-versus-hom-ref AF bias, PL/GQ validation on this caller, and independent missingness handling passed.
Reference blocks, END spans, one N_ALT>1 candidate site, low-GQ block triage, and joint-genotyping boundary passed.
BCF and tabix conversion, 32-record region agreement, observed plain-gzip error diagnosis, and 350/361 QUAL>30 Writer result passed.
Fresh VCF proves the shipped viewer prints QUAL=0.0 and preserves missing QUAL as dot; source py_compile passed.
Fresh caller fields parsed GT, GQ, PL, and GL; relative GL-to-PL scaling was demonstrated and an emitted GQ=99 was preserved rather than reconstructed from PL.
